title: ShieldCare Claim Excess: the Handling Charge on an Invoiced Settlement
content:
## The charge

A handling charge is added where the store credit account on the profile, held under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts, requires a purchase order. Its size turns on the excess owed on the
Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan measured against the plan's own deductible figure.

| What the records show | The handling charge on an invoiced settlement |
| --- | --- |
| a purchase order is required on the account, and the excess owed is above the plan's own deductible figure | 18.00 |
| a purchase order is required on the account, and the excess owed is no more than the plan's own deductible figure | 9.00 |
| every other profile | no handling charge is added to an invoiced settlement |

## Both sides of the comparison

On a plan whose deductible is 99.00: an excess owed of 99.01 is above the plan's own deductible figure
and carries 18.00; an excess owed of exactly 99.00 is no more than it and carries 9.00. Where no
purchase order is required on the account, no handling charge is added whatever the excess owed comes
to.

## Cases on hypothetical figures

| Purchase order required | Plan's deductible | Excess owed | Handling charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| no | 99.00 | 240.00 | none |
| yes | 99.00 | 45.00 | 9.00 |
| yes | 99.00 | 99.00 | 9.00 |
| yes | 99.00 | 240.00 | 18.00 |
